Irish jockey Tom O'Brien dies aged 39

Tom O'Brien, an Irish jump jockey who won at the Cheltenham Festival, has died at the age of 39. Tributes have been paid following his death. O'Brien was the nephew of Ballydoyle trainer Aidan O'Brien.
